baseline_models.focus_anchor: The answer at words 5-13 moves from the invoked objects being lost from the speakers to the claim that they had never called any thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The corrective turn escalates a relational failure into categorical cancellation: first the invoked referents cannot be found, then no knowable or reportable object is allowed to own the earlier calls.

activation_trace.role: The image of losing possession or location makes the first clause a failed recovery of the invoked referents and links it to the repeated causative verb.
Vocal summons supplies the prior relation whose addressee is now unavailable.
A thing as something knowable and reportable supplies the category that the speakers retroactively empty.

changed_reading.before: They report that their former objects of invocation are absent.
changed_reading.after: Their answer escalates from lost contact to retrospective nullification: no callable, reportable object remains to own the prior worship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening construction at words 2-3 places the missing referents below, short of, or apart from Allah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial and comparative range of the preposition makes the substitutes not merely others but lower or near intermediaries that stop short of the goal; their disappearance exposes the failure built into that rank.

activation_trace.role: Proximity that falls short of an endpoint supplies a failed-intermediary geometry.
Otherness and lower standing identify the invoked referents as ranked substitutes.
Worship and the worshipped supply the authority against which every substitute is measured.

changed_reading.before: They invoked beings other than Allah.
changed_reading.after: They installed lower intermediaries in a hierarchy, and judgment reveals that every intermediary stopped short of the only authority able to remain present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The spoken correction at words 4-13 is followed immediately by the designation at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: The answer can confess the nullity of the invoked objects while also denying the speakers' own history. Speech that attributes what was not the case covers the earlier practice, so the utterance reenacts the covering named at the close.

activation_trace.role: Speech that asserts or attributes what was not so makes the correction available as defensive rewriting.
Concealment and disappearance let the referents vanish inside the speakers' revised account.
Covering supplies the functional description of a statement that hides prior allegiance.

changed_reading.before: The speakers give a straightforward answer about absent gods.
changed_reading.after: Their answer is double-edged: it accidentally admits the referents' nullity while deliberately covering the history that made them referents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier exact call-besides frame contrasts Allah's decisive judgment with the substitutes' inability to decide any thing. The focus answer therefore sounds like a forensic verdict on capacity: the invoked referents count as nothing because they can neither adjudicate nor act when judgment arrives.

activation_trace.role: Decisive judgment supplies the asymmetric capacity that Allah exercises and the invoked substitutes lack.
The summons identifies the same relationship later disowned in the focus.
Lower otherness marks the powerless adjudicators as substitutes rather than peers.
The reportable thing is the expressly negated object of their judicial capacity.
The same category anchors the focus claim that no object had been called.

structural_cues: 40:20 and 40:74 share the call-besides construction and a negated thing-object, while 40:20 adds an explicit judgment contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated construction and the contrast in adjudicative capacity; I infer that incapacity is why the referents collapse into nothing at 40:74. A live alternative is that the final claim is only a panicked lie about past practice.

changed_reading.before: The missing referents are absent objects.
changed_reading.after: They are legally and operationally null at the moment of judgment, so the speakers' nothing inadvertently states the verdict that their denial tries to evade.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, calling is a directional relation that should terminate in response and is identified with worship. The false invitation has no valid reciprocal call, the disbelievers' call remains inside loss, and the divine call promises response. The focus disappearance is therefore a broken address circuit, not only spatial absence.

activation_trace.role: Calling as directed speech supplies a purported reciprocal relation that is declared unavailable in both temporal domains.
Repeated summons places the disbelievers' attempted appeal inside an already failed channel.
Deviation from the intended destination characterizes the failed call before the focus repeats the root.
The commanded summons supplies the valid direction of address.
A returned answer supplies the completion that false invocation lacks.
Submissive worship identifies refusal of the true call-response relation as more than a communication failure.
The disowned summons anchors the broken circuit in the focus.
Loss converts failed response into the disappearance of both addressee and caller from the right relation.

structural_cues: 40:41-43 stages competing invitations and denies the false invitation any valid call in either world.
40:50 places the disbelievers' appeal wholly within loss, while 40:60 pairs the proper call with response and worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competing calls, an explicit response, and a call characterized by loss; I infer a circuit in which wrong address produces nonresponse and relational disappearance. The alternative is to keep each occurrence as an independent use of ordinary calling.

changed_reading.before: The objects once invoked cannot now be located.
changed_reading.after: False worship is an address with no responding endpoint; their disappearance from us is the final exposure of a call that never completed a valid relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier polarity rejects the call of Allah alone but grants trust when partnership is introduced. The focus designation of the disbelievers is thus causal and diagnostic: their loss grows from a selective acceptance filter that receives divided authority and covers exclusive address.

activation_trace.role: Calling supplies the exclusive address that the audience rejects.
Denial of truth names the negative response to undivided invocation.
Shared participation supplies the divided arrangement that reverses their response.
Heart-settling assent supplies the positive response perversely reserved for partnership.
The closing designation anchors the selective denial process in the focus.

structural_cues: 40:12 sets exclusive invocation and partnership in a direct rejection-acceptance polarity; 40:74 closes its answer with the same rejecting class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the polarity of rejection and assent; I infer that this selective filter is the humanly enacted path completed by divine misguidance. A live alternative treats the closing designation as a generic class label without an internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers are the group to whom the final generalization applies.
changed_reading.after: Disbelievers are identified by a specific allegiance filter: they refuse undivided address, accept shared authority, and finally lose the partners their filter installed.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier divine-misguidance formula follows persistent doubt and categorical speech after evidence. The immediate sequence then moves through being turned away, denial, bodily dragging, and interrogation of partnership before the focus names disappearance and divine misguidance. The final causative verb completes a direction already enacted epistemically, verbally, and bodily.

activation_trace.role: An unfounded categorical utterance supplies the speech act immediately preceding the earlier misguidance formula.
Departure from guidance establishes the earlier formula as the outcome of maintained doubt and denial.
Being turned away supplies the first directional motion in the immediate sequence.
Contradiction of truth supplies the epistemic action that sustains the wrong direction.
Dragging and extension materialize compelled motion after chosen redirection.
Partnership identifies the relation tested immediately before its referents vanish.
The repeated departure root seals object-loss and agent-misguidance into one directional result.

structural_cues: 40:34 uses the same divine-misguidance formula after prolonged doubt and a denial spoken after evidence.
40:69-73 proceeds from redirection through denial and forced movement to an interrogation about partnership immediately before the focus answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered directional and speech events; I infer that the last causative verb gathers them into a completed trajectory. A materially live alternative is that the images are adjacent judgments without a single causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Allah causes the disbelievers to stray after their gods disappear.
changed_reading.after: The causative close ratifies and completes an enacted trajectory: truth was contradicted, direction repeatedly diverted, bodies dragged, and the chosen partnership finally became unlocatable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places every thing inside divine knowledge, denies that any thing is hidden at exposure, and names Allah as creator of every thing. The focus claim cannot erase the past from that field. Its negated object instead oscillates between evasive deletion and an involuntary demotion of the false referents from efficacious thinghood.

activation_trace.role: The universally knowable object supplies the maximal domain against which the focus negation is heard.
Disclosure to a knower makes retrospective erasure of the speakers' history unavailable.
Hiddenness supplies the state expressly denied on the day when the focus answer is given.
The unrestricted reportable object makes the disclosure claim exhaustive.
Origination supplies the divine ground of whatever can truly count as an existent object.
Universal thinghood places all real referents under the creator rather than beside Him.
The focus negation anchors the attempted deletion or demotion in the speakers' own words.

structural_cues: 40:7 makes every thing an object of encompassing mercy and knowledge.
40:16 denies hiddenness to any thing at exposure, and 40:62 places every thing under divine creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal knowledge, exposure, creation, and the focus negation; I infer that literal erasure is impossible and that the statement either lies or denies the referents effective reality. The live alternative is ordinary emphatic denial with no ontological force.

changed_reading.before: The speakers claim that they never invoked anything.
changed_reading.after: Inside a field where every real thing is known, exposed, and created, their sentence cannot delete history; it instead exposes the invoked referents as nonentities in authority, even while trying to hide the invocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah ends with another punishment-triggered speech that professes sole trust in Allah and disavows prior partnership, followed by the declaration that this trust cannot benefit its speakers. That mirror strengthens the focus answer as a too-late forensic severance rather than a saving return.

activation_trace.role: Overt speech supplies the second late confession that mirrors the focus answer.
Professed heart-settling assent supplies the claimed reversal after punishment becomes visible.
Renunciation supplies the explicit attempt to sever the former partnership.
Shared participation identifies the relation now repudiated.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the expressly denied efficacy of the late profession.
Defensive rewriting anchors the earlier confession in the focus.
The renunciation branch makes the closing label resonate ironically with the speakers' attempted disavowal.

structural_cues: 40:84 repeats punishment-triggered speech, sole allegiance, and repudiation of former partnership.
40:85 immediately denies salvific benefit to that late profession and again closes on the disbelievers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later verbal mirror and its explicit nonbenefit; I infer that 40:74 is likewise forensic disavowal after the point of effective return. The alternative is that the two speeches serve different rhetorical functions despite their shared timing.

changed_reading.before: The answer is a momentary denial prompted by the disappearance of the invoked objects.
changed_reading.after: It is one instance of a repeated too-late strategy: punishment produces correct-sounding severance from partnership, but verbal realignment after exposure cannot repair the prior allegiance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends cultic invocation into social patronage, but it remains anchored in the focus's relational loss and the claim-affiliation branch of its call verb, while 40:47-48 tests follower dependence and 40:73 tests partnership. Downstream prose should present it as a social mechanism activated by the sequence, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The objects are lost from us at word 5, and the speakers disown their calling relationship at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Loyal succession supplies the patron-follower bond whose promised support is tested.
Sufficiency supplies the demanded ability to relieve dependents from a share of liability.
Judgment between people closes the possibility that patrons can privately redistribute the burden.
Partnership names the shared relation interrogated immediately before it dissolves.
Claim and affiliation let invocation function as an asserted patronal bond.
Loss makes the claimed patrons unavailable precisely when their dependents seek support.

changed_reading.before: The invoked objects cannot be found.
changed_reading.after: A claimed patronage network dissolves at liability: followers cannot obtain relief, and the affiliations they invoked no longer acknowledge or sustain them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the form-distant D-Ayn-Ayn target supplied for the focus's D-Ayn-Waw root. It remains anchored at word 10 and is activated by the surah's ordered redirection and dragging images. Downstream prose must label it a split-root material analogy, not the lexical meaning of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The prior calling at word 10 stands between the objects' loss at word 5 and the agents' causative misguidance at word 15.

activation_trace.role: Forceful pushing supplies a material counterimage for the true call that the audience resisted.
Turning away supplies directional displacement immediately before the punishment sequence.
Dragging gives bodily form to compelled movement along the wrong direction.
The non-dominant split target lets the disowned calling echo as misdirected propulsion.
Departure from the intended way supplies the endpoint of the push-turn-drag sequence.

changed_reading.before: They called false referents, which then disappeared.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, misdirected calling participates in a propulsion circuit: resistance to the true call culminates in forced redirection while the chosen endpoints vanish.

strongest_changes: The exact 40:20 call-besides and thing frame turns the focus's nothing into a verdict of adjudicative and operational nullity.
The 40:43, 40:50, and 40:60 sequence reconstructs invocation as a call-response relation whose false channel has no responding endpoint.
The ordered movement from redirection and denial through dragging and interrogated partnership makes the final divine misguidance the completion of an enacted trajectory.
The 40:84-85 mirror makes the focus answer a too-late forensic disavowal rather than a saving correction.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence preserved several coexisting mechanisms that a local reading could collapse: judicial incapacity, failed address, selective allegiance, directional completion, attempted erasure under total disclosure, and dissolved patronage.
remaining_uncertainties: The claim of having called nothing may be a conscious lie, an involuntary confession of the referents' nullity, or both at once.
The missing referents may include only cultic objects or may also activate social patrons and leaders.
The exact relation between chosen redirection and divine causation remains directional and forensic rather than fully specified.
The D-Ayn-Ayn split-root activation is useful only as an explicitly qualified material analogy.
